title: How SAP and Microsoft Innovate Together to Deliver AI Value for the Enterprise
summary: SAP is making Joule even more interoperable with Microsoft, enabling agents to access and reason over business data, context, and tools.
body_markdown:
Today, SAP is making[Joule Work](https://www.sap.com/products/artificial-intelligence/joule-work.html) even more interoperable by taking advantage of the latest capabilities in Microsoft[Work IQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/) , announced at Microsoft Ignite.


Stop navigating apps, start directing the business with Joule Work


[Learn how](https://www.sap.com/products/artificial-intelligence/joule-work.html)


Joule Work delivers access to processes, transactions, and unified operational data. The addition of Work IQ provides organizational context found in Microsoft 365 and beyond, closing the gap between where work happens and where business runs.


As AI spreads across disconnected enterprise environments, keeping work connected and maintaining oversight becomes exponentially harder. That’s why SAP collaborates with Microsoft to solve both challenges and unlock exponential AI value.


SAP combines expertise and capabilities with Microsoft’s to deliver more AI-driven business outcomes to our customers than either could individually, with security, governance, and responsible AI built in from day one. Countless customers already depend on[SAP Business AI Platform](https://www.sap.com/products/ai-platform.html) ,[Joule Work](https://www.sap.com/products/artificial-intelligence.html) ,[Microsoft Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot) ,[Microsoft 365](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-enterprise) ,[Azure](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us) , and more to get work done.


Many are connecting SAP business processes with Microsoft AI experiences today. For example, Nestlé uses[RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure](https://www.microsoft.com/en/customers/story/23963-nestle-azure) to modernize and operate its SAP environment. The company also[leverages Joule Assistants](https://news.sap.com/2026/10/sap-connect-sap-puts-autonomous-enterprise-to-work/) to improve accounts receivable workflows.


## **AI value compounds when data, logic, and control come together**


In Joule Work, people describe what they want to achieve. Joule Assistants coordinate Joule Agents to execute multi-step workflows across SAP and third-party systems. They connect the relevant data, tools, and applications, all within SAP permissions and controls, to inform every decision, action, and agent-driven workflow.


[SAP Business AI Platform](https://www.sap.com/products/ai-platform.html) is the architecture underneath, connecting data foundations and bidirectional workflows. Within it,[SAP Business Data Cloud](https://www.sap.com/products/data-cloud.html) provides the AI-ready data foundation: semantically rich, business-ready data products grounded in SAP’s business processes and relationships to power more accurate, context-aware AI.


This is also a key place where SAP is collaborating with Microsoft to deliver compounding value. SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for[Microsoft Fabric](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-fabric/resources/data-101/what-is-fabric?msockid=3fbb62dac002676017337530c11166e5) enables a unified data foundation across SAP and Microsoft environments through bidirectional, zero-copy data integration. Neither system sits in front of the other; the intelligence flows both ways. With this shared foundation in place, Joule Work and Microsoft Copilot draw on the same trusted data to inform decisions and orchestrate reliable agent-driven workflows across platforms and systems, without duplication or loss of context.


With the[release](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/message/19:642bf47d-95c8-454a-b849-8f5ac5c67fd4_b3442073-2dde-4619-8726-9ea5d731829d@unq.gbl.spaces/1794516887594?context=%7B%22contextType%22%3A%22chat%22%7D) earlier this month of the agent gateway and the open A2A protocol, agents built with Microsoft Copilot Studio can[delegate](https://architecture.learning.sap.com/news/2026/10/27/a2a-agent-gateway-interoperability) SAP-specific work directly to Joule Agents rather than requiring teams to recreate business processes from scratch. Security, identity, and policies carry through automatically, ensuring consistent execution across HR, finance, supply chain, and other SAP workloads.


[SAP AI Agent Hub](https://www.sap.com/products/artificial-intelligence/ai-agent-hub.html) , part of SAP Business AI Platform, gives organizations telemetry and lifecycle visibility across SAP, Microsoft, and third-party agents as they multiply across environments. It keeps every agent observable, accountable, and governed.


Administrators can see which agents are running, how they’re being used, and the value delivered—and then use that information to have agents do even more. Think of it as an all-in-one air traffic control, measurement, and upgrade system for all your AI agents. And the best part is that the more you connect data, workflows, and agents, the more value those AI agents deliver.


## **SAP AI capabilities available across Microsoft 365 experiences**


Today, Joule and Copilot offer many capabilities across the productivity tools people use every day. For example, employees can use Joule Work to access SAP business context directly from Microsoft Teams. Developers using Microsoft Copilot Studio can extend business processes without manually building SAP expertise into every agent, and incorporate SAP agents into their organization’s broader workflows. As Work IQ capabilities roll out over time, Joule Work will become progressively more intelligent and integrated across M365 environments.


SAP is also working with Microsoft to bring enterprise process intelligence into even more places work already happens.We’re also continuing to enhance Joule Work and Microsoft Copilot’s ability to work bi-directionally. Soon, these AI agents will surface SAP insights inside Microsoft 365 as soon as they’re relevant, while SAP applications draw on Teams, SharePoint, and the rest of the Microsoft 365 environment to better inform every decision and action, supercharging measurable business outcomes.


## **Three ways to extend Microsoft AI with Joule Agents and SAP business processes**


Microsoft practitioners have several opportunities right now to improve their workflows:


- Discover and use Joule Agents from Microsoft workflows without rebuilding SAP business logic.
- Extend Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio with SAP business processes, data, and expertise using SAP’s pre-built connectors, agent templates, and the A2A integration pattern available in Copilot Studio. From procurement matching to inventory checks, SAP business logic is available as governed agent capabilities that Copilot can call on demand.
- Leverage SAP AI Agent Hub tomonitor agent activity across SAP and Microsoft environments with greater visibility into usage, execution, and outcomes.


Are you a Microsoft practitioner ready to bring all that value into your daily work on behalf of important stakeholders?[Learn how to get started here](https://www.sap.com/partners/find/microsoft#benefits) .


---


Brenda Bown is chief marketing officer for SAP Business AI Platform and Joule at SAP.
